findings: nw_wifi_stop destroys ath11k PCI, QRTR, MHI, mac80211 and cfg80211 and therefore must run before INTID800, Bus Master and PERST are removed.
The runtime b5q TI Host and Device override bytes are identical; the original repeater module separately exposes a reset GPIO operation.
The stock DWC3 node requires disable-clk-gating, dis_u2_susphy and USB2 LPM disable. No unrelated PHY field is guessed.
SM8550 falling-edge GPIO configuration uses detection value 2 and polarity bit 1. UART14 active RX is bias-disable while IBS wake GPIO must idle high.
The userland build preserves and compares original bluetoothd entitlements. WCN6855 hw2.1 corrected-name failure intentionally falls back to the present legacy firmware pair.
Apple80211 event names are zero-filled for the complete fixed 16-byte kev payload; delayed TX refreshes gIf and skips ifnet statistics until the BSD interface exists.
Wi-Fi readiness accepts only zero or EEXIST and retries all other vnode errors once per second without blocking nw_wifi_step.

U3 capture requires CCS and PED and can be consumed only from the role thread poll or setPowerState path; xHCI READ64/WRITE64 retain first-HSE capture but cannot trigger first-U3 disk synchronization.
Role reset keeps USB2/USB3 PHY reset asserted for the eUSB2 initialization plus 2 ms and waits 1 ms after releasing CORESOFTRESET before restoring role and clock fields.
